description: This file is a shell script that sets up the Apple App Store Connect API key in macOS Keychain and optionally updates environment variables in a specified env file. It handles argument parsing, validation, storing the key securely, and environment configuration.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: upsert_env_line
methods.description: Inserts or updates an environment variable line in the env file.

methods.name: delete_env_line
methods.description: Removes an environment variable line from the env file.
